firmPage.title: An independent practice built for law, finance and regulation.
firmPage.intro: Ackmann Law Firm was founded to serve clients who need more than legal drafting — a counsel who understands how financial institutions, regulators and businesses actually operate. Based in Jerusalem, the practice serves companies, investors and individuals across Israel and internationally.
firmPage.approachBody: Every matter starts with the same question: what does the client actually need to move forward? The firm favors direct, precise advice over generic memoranda — grounded in the practical realities of banking, compliance and public-sector process, not just the letter of the law.
firmPage.perspectiveBody: Legal problems rarely stay inside legal boundaries. A financing agreement raises regulatory questions; a compliance issue has commercial consequences. The firm's background across banking, financial regulation and public-sector work means these dimensions are considered together from the outset, not addressed as an afterthought.
firmPage.philosophyBody: Clear communication, realistic expectations, and responsiveness. Clients should never have to guess where a matter stands or translate legal jargon on their own. The firm keeps engagements focused and proportionate to what is actually at stake.

jonathanPage.bioExtended: Jonathan Ackmann founded the firm to bring a combined legal, financial and regulatory perspective to clients navigating Israel's business and public-sector environment. His background spans financial regulation and compliance work at KPMG Somekh Chaikin, public-sector legal matters, and banking and international-client work at Bank Leumi. He was admitted to the Israeli Bar in December 2024.

banking-finance.seoTitle: Banking Lawyer in Israel | Banking Disputes
banking-finance.h1: Banking Law and Bank Disputes in Israel
banking-finance.intro: Support dealing with Israeli banks: blocked accounts, transfer refusals, complaints and bank documentation, grounded in a practical understanding of how financial institutions actually operate.
banking-finance.approach: Every banking matter starts with the facts and the bank's own correspondence, with no promised outcome. The firm is not a US tax practice: when a question becomes genuinely fiscal, a specialized CPA or tax advisor may be recommended.

faq.question: What should I do if my bank blocks my account in Israel?
faq.answer: Request the reason in writing along with the documents the bank expects, then build a structured file before filing a complaint. Legal support helps frame the request and track deadlines, without guaranteeing the outcome.

faq.question: Can an Israeli bank ask for the source of funds?
faq.answer: Yes, as part of its compliance obligations (notably CRS/FATCA). Document requests should stay proportionate; a lawyer can help you respond and, if needed, challenge an excessive request.

faq.question: How do I file a complaint with the Bank of Israel?
faq.answer: First send a complaint (פניות הציבור) to the bank itself, then, if the response is unsatisfactory, escalate to the relevant Bank of Israel department with a documented file.

faq.question: What is the נתוני אשראי credit-data system?
faq.answer: It is Israel's credit-data system, which can contain errors affecting your access to credit. You can review your report and request a correction if you find an error.

corporate-commercial.seoTitle: Commercial Lawyer in Israel | Business & Contracts
corporate-commercial.intro: Corporate structuring, commercial agreements and day-to-day legal support for companies operating in Israel and abroad.
corporate-commercial.approach: Commercial advice is kept proportionate to the size and stage of the business — precise where it matters, without unnecessary complexity. The firm notably supports businesses and entrepreneurs who do not necessarily have an in-house legal department.

compliance.h1: Regulatory Compliance, FATCA and CRS in Israel
compliance.intro: FATCA, QI and CRS compliance for businesses and financial institutions, grounded in hands-on experience with documentary review and regulatory controls.
keyMatters: Sampling controls on US account populations
compliance.approach: Compliance advice starts from how a business actually operates, so FATCA, QI and CRS requirements are integrated into existing processes rather than added as a separate burden.

administrative-public-law.intro: Legal support on public procurement, tenders and administrative processes involving Israeli public-sector bodies.
administrative-public-law.approach: Public-sector matters are approached with attention to procedure — administrative processes have their own rules, and getting them right matters as much as the underlying substance.

dispute-resolution.intro: Resolution of commercial and financial disputes, with a preference for practical outcomes over prolonged conflict where possible.
dispute-resolution.approach: Every dispute is assessed first on its merits and its cost — litigation is pursued when it is the right tool, not the default one.

private-clients.h1: Legal Support Between France and Israel
private-clients.intro: Personal legal advice for individuals facing banking, regulatory, succession or real-estate matters between France and Israel.
keyMatters: Personal banking difficulties (blocked accounts, transfers, FATCA/CRS)
France–Israel matters (powers of attorney, representation, coordination)
Succession and estate matters with an Israeli or international element
Real estate with an international element
services: Personal legal advice on banking and regulatory matters
France–Israel procedures and powers of attorney
Coordinating succession matters with specialized professionals
Support for property purchases or sales with an international element
private-clients.approach: Private clients receive the same precision and clarity as institutional clients, with advice translated plainly and free of legal or regulatory jargon. The firm supports certain succession and estate matters with an Israeli or international element and coordinates, where needed, the involvement of specialized professionals.
